current_ci_behavior: PRs compare GITHUB_SHA with GITHUB_BASE_REF using testsBranch GITHUB_SHA; push compares GITHUB_SHA with a fixed reference commit; each branch environment is built and tested sequentially.
portability_implication: Within-job comparison reduces some host drift, but branch order, build cache, wp-env lifecycle, and fixed-reference compatibility still affect absolute values.
required_validation: Preserve branch order, run key, wp-env lifecycle, build metadata, commit IDs, testsBranch, and WP version in validation artifacts.

current_ci_behavior: Default TEST_ROUNDS is 1; when more rounds are requested, raw arrays are flattened before q25, q50, q75, and cnt are computed.
portability_implication: The CI score is a small retained-sample q50 by default; local dense-sweep volatility does not automatically map to CI volatility.
required_validation: Run paired repeated compact rows on CI or preserve per-run raw files so q50, CV, ordering, and tail movement can be recomputed.

current_ci_behavior: Typing sends 11 characters with Playwright type(), discards the first character, and reports 10 retained sums of keydown plus keypress plus keyup EventDispatch durations.
portability_implication: Any portability lane must keep the same retained/throwaway and held-key semantics unless it declares a new metric.
required_validation: Record delay env vars, retained count, throwaway count, first-three-key distribution, input helper family, hold/tap mode, and trace placement.

current_ci_behavior: Curated artifacts store q25, q50, q75, and cnt; the workflow summary prints q50 with quartile percentages; the push publisher sends q50 only for each metric and base metric.
portability_implication: External dashboards mostly see q50, so reliability and volatility require archived artifacts or extra publishing.
required_validation: Archive raw and curated compact-manifest artifacts and add q25, q75, cnt, CV, or per-run rows before threshold changes.

current_ci_behavior: The script computes percent change for display, but this repository code does not show a numeric performance fail threshold; the GitHub job fails on test/script failure.
portability_implication: Pass/fail portability is about preserving evidence for review or external dashboards, not matching a hidden in-repo threshold.
required_validation: Document the external dashboard or reviewer threshold policy before treating a local q50 movement as a CI pass/fail prediction.
